main.description: Declares that this account operates a Colibri labeler and describes the badges it issues. The Colibri equivalent of `app.bsky.labeler.service`. Labels themselves stay standard `com.atproto.label` labels, served from the `#atproto_labeler` service endpoint in this account's DID document.

badgeDefinitions.description: Every badge this labeler can issue. A label value absent from this list is not a recognised badge.

badgeDefinition.description: Metadata for a single badge. `identifier` is the `val` carried by the corresponding label.

identifier.description: The label value, lowercase kebab-case, as it appears in `com.atproto.label` records.

name.description: Short display name shown on the badge itself.

precedence.description: Sort order when a user holds several badges. Lower sorts first, so the lowest value is the default primary badge.
